title: spring.discovery.nacos
description: Named blocks: one property per Nacos server, e.g. spring.discovery.nacos.main.server=... The block name is mandatory and becomes part of the backend bean name (nacos.<name>), which consumers cite for discovery (discovery=nacos.main). There is no default/unnamed block. The instance identity under spring.discovery (service-name, addr, weight, metadata) is owned by the cloud/discovery core and shared by every configured center; see the 'instance' definition.

server.description: Nacos server host:port; setting it activates this block

ping.description: Probe the server once at startup and fail fast when unreachable; false (default) skips the probe.

health.description: Contributes a health.Indicator bean for this block; set false to disable.

instance.description: Bound under spring.discovery by the cloud/discovery core; shared by every configured center. service-name is the registration intent signal: set means this process registers into all centers, unset means pure consumer.

spring.discovery.service-name.description: Logical service name to advertise; empty = pure consumer

spring.discovery.id.description: Instance id override; ignored by the nacos backend (instances are identified by ip:port)

spring.discovery.metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value attributes stored with the instance
